qualification.status: Cubature 1.12.2-0.1.4.0, built for Cleanroom and Forge from a clean checkout of this commit; 262 Cubature tests per loader, 76 Cleanroom and 74 Forge lab tests, 0 failures. riven.ps1 ci passed with this pin. Native runs of fresh Riven worlds with classes identical to this build: the storage save scenarios (save-all flush with WorldEvent.Save, clean flushes, the real 900-tick periodic save) passed; a BASELINE flight showed each periodic save queueing paced snapshots; PREFETCH flight-and-settle runs passed with flight tick p95 36 to 39 ms and the same 20,538-cube settle floor as earlier builds, and saved blocks of 82,215 cubes away from spawn matched across runs and against e97f6a74 and 0bbd6716; the lab generation and maintenance contracts passed; signs filled into watched cubes reached the client through whole-cube packets with exact sizing off and on.
qualification.contents: Version 0.1.4.0 with Orthrus Research as copyright holder and vendor and compile-only build inputs that a standalone clone fetches; since the initial commit, the manual CI workflow's build-input step, deliveryMode as the only delivery input, the periodic autosave as a named provider call, explicit delivery generation timing with run-or-await for work in flight, and sender-chosen PacketCubes sizing.
